note: Salesforce Address provides one field widget, salesforce_ready_address ('Salesforce-ready Address', AddressDefaultWidgetStreetAsTextArea), for address fields: it renders the street as a single textarea to match Salesforce's multi-line street storage. No config/permissions/plugins/Drush of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real, local field + form-display config on the user entity, verified by pure config reads. All fixtures are namespaced field_sfa_* and removed on cleanup (scoped delete of the field only, never a broad purge).

evals.prompt: What does the Salesforce Address module provide, and what is the widget's id and field type?
evals.expected_output: It provides the salesforce_ready_address widget ('Salesforce-ready Address') for address fields. It renders the street as a single textarea (instead of separate address lines) to match how Salesforce stores a multi-line street.

evals.prompt: Why would I use the Salesforce-ready Address widget instead of the default address widget when syncing to Salesforce?
evals.expected_output: Salesforce address fields store the street as one multi-line value; the salesforce_ready_address widget captures the street in a single textarea, so mapping a Drupal address field's street to a Salesforce street field (e.g. MailingStreet) is clean without concatenating separate lines.

evals.prompt: How do I apply the Salesforce-ready Address widget to an address field on an entity?
evals.expected_output: Select 'Salesforce-ready Address' (salesforce_ready_address) as the widget for the address field on the entity's Manage form display (core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type = salesforce_ready_address).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the user account form has an address field field_sfa_known. Inspect the live form display and state which widget it uses.
evals.expected_output: It uses the salesforce_ready_address widget: core.entity_form_display.user.user.default has content.field_sfa_known.type = salesforce_ready_address.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the user entity has a field field_sfa_known used with a Salesforce widget. Inspect the field storage and give its field type.
evals.expected_output: The field type is address: field.storage.user.field_sfa_known has type address (the contrib Address field the salesforce_ready_address widget targets).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the user account form has an address field field_sfa_task using the default address widget. Switch it to the Salesforce-ready Address widget so the street is captured as a single textarea. Apply the change to the live site.
On this Drupal site, add an address field field_sfa_new to user accounts and set its form widget to the Salesforce-ready Address widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An address field field_sfa_new exists on user (field.storage.user.field_sfa_new type = address) and its widget in core.entity_form_display.user.user.default is salesforce_ready_address.
